summary: Short kerb at a junction mouth beside a main road, with no room to stop.
reasons: Junction with islands and give-way markings
Verge is trees and sloping bank

drivers.seclusion: Bush to the south and houses 30 m or more away, but the stretch is in the open junction with the main road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is the turning area beside a traffic island; no clear level ground to pull off.
drivers.traffic: Busy main road alongside; vehicles turning through the junction.
drivers.convention: No parked vehicles seen along this kerb.

flags: Steep: about 6% fall over the 25 m (the data's 28% mean is a DEM artefact)
Junction mouth, a van would block turning traffic
sun_shade: Open at the junction; tree canopy to the south and east.
